summary: Ruanyun Edai Technology Inc. (NASDAQ: RYET) filed a Form 6-K on October 2, 2026, furnishing a press release with preliminary unaudited first-half fiscal 2027 revenue guidance. The China-based software issuer expects revenue of US$9.3–9.5 million (RMB63.0–64.5 million) for the six months ended September 30, 2026, versus US$0.37 million a year earlier, above full-year revenue for each of the past two fiscal years. Campus services contribute roughly 53–56%. No board recommendation, advisor, or transaction terms are stated; this is a routine operational update, not a special situation.
